summary: Publishes plugin runtime 0.2.1 for plugin SDK 0.3.1, patches each dependent public package, and detects workspace dependency drift before immutable publication.
userImpact: Plugin package consumers can install a runtime package whose declared plugin SDK dependency matches the current public SDK release.

instructions: Use @enterpriseglue/plugin-runtime 0.2.1 with @enterpriseglue/plugin-sdk 0.3.1, installer 0.2.4, Plugin Manager 0.1.4, backend host 0.7.1, frontend host 0.9.1, and the matching 0.2.4 runtime/RBAC and 0.1.4 manager Helm charts.

changes: The runtime, host, installer, and manager APIs are unchanged; only their immutable package versions and resolved workspace dependency metadata change.

documentation: Release notes record the corrected package dependency contracts, coupled chart versions, and publication guard.
rollback: Continue using the previous package set only as one immutable unit; no database or configuration rollback is required.
validation: Protected plugin package build, pack, publication, and registry verification
